additional_info.subject: Problem SiD Limit Power ELM
additional_info.body:
Hello Support,
We are in commissioning for Dynamic Loading Management system, with SICAM, where the behavior in two chargers are very strange.
When the DLM reduce the power, some moment the charger go down, auto setup the EVSE Max power.
We have tested also without DLM, reducing the power manually, one moment the power go Down, so, the DLM not cause the power reduction, is the charger itself.
Charger Serial, 170002002:
ELMS (error): EVSE Global Error = true, sending the power to 4kW. The EV is a VOLVO e Truck.
of 240kWh.
Charger Serial, 170002131:
This phenomenon is “downscaling”, why ocurre this? The EV is a VOLVO e Truck, of 240kWh.
Please find attached the logs files.
Jesús Tello R.
Business Developer
Conversion Solutions para PV & BESS & H2
